reviews.title: Best SFF case on the market.
reviews.comment: Absolutely love building in this case. pletny of room for routing cables, and perfect slot and hole placement for every custom lightning combo you can imagine. literally cant see any cables with this build. plenty of space to mount aio up top. lots of psu space underneath. absolutely stellar quality inside and out. love the way it looks and it pumps air through the case like nobodies business. doesnt wobble, fits nice on or underneath a desk, perfect for those who want to stare blindly at the beauty of their system. Its a steal at this price.

reviews.title: Great case but read before you buy for an mATX board
reviews.comment:
This is a great little case for the price. It fits an mATX board but If you are going to use this you should get cable extensions and run them through the top before installing the board.
Cons: The mATX boards cover up access to the back so you have to run your MB cable through the top. The board covers the fans by about 1/4 inch so if you plan on installing reverse blade fans you have to do it before you install the MB. Once its all in it is a very compact build. This might be more made for an ITX board but it still works.
Overall: I am still giving this 5 stars because its a well built case! The front and side glass come off so you can work without interference. The air flow is great and the basement has plenty of room for Hard drives and cable management.
reviews.author: Matthew Alexander

reviews.title: Great case, with a few limitations, read further.
reviews.comment: The media could not be loaded.  https://m.media-amazon.com/images/I/F1fB7cNoQ1L.mp4 https://m.media-amazon.com/images/I/71krehPOVdL._SY256.jpg Great case for the price.  This is my fourth time building in this case, so I feel like I have some experience to share.  First of all, she is a looker.  The supplied fans add value.  Be aware there is no RGB controller built into the case, so you will need your Motherboard to have an aRGB controller header, or buy an aftermarket one.  Second, it checks all the boxes, has room for storage expansion, and holds large modern GPUs.  Thirdly, While it holds the square mATX sized Mobos, it really looks best if you use slim mATX mobos.  Airflow is great.  Plenty of room for a 240mm AIO water cooler.  It does feel very lightweight (cheap?) But once all the components are installed, it stiffens right up.  Also both glass panels are removable which makes it easier to work inside the case.  It has plenty of anchors for zip ties to keep up with tidy cable management.
